GRAND GROUP CORPORATION stands as a prominent chemical manufacturing enterprise strategically located in the heart of Ningbo, one of China's most dynamic industrial and port cities. Headquartered at 13F, Pacific Plaza, No.555 Jingjia Road in Ningbo, Zhejiang Province, the company has established itself as a significant player in the Chinese chemical industry, leveraging its prime location in the Yangtze River Delta Economic Zone.

Since its establishment, GRAND GROUP CORPORATION has dedicated itself to the research, development, and production of high-quality chemical products, serving both domestic and international markets. The company's strategic position in Ningbo provides exceptional advantages, including proximity to one of the world's busiest ports, facilitating efficient global trade and logistics operations. This geographical advantage, combined with access to Zhejiang's robust industrial infrastructure and skilled workforce, has enabled the company to maintain competitive edges in production efficiency and market reach.

The corporation specializes in manufacturing a diverse range of chemical products, maintaining strict quality control standards and adhering to international safety and environmental regulations. With a commitment to innovation and sustainable development, GRAND GROUP CORPORATION continues to invest in advanced technologies and equipment, ensuring its products meet the evolving demands of various industries while contributing to the economic growth of the region and maintaining responsible environmental practices.
